defects: J is left as an arbitrary matrix instead of the fixed standard symplectic form (Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (-1) 1 0) used to define symplecticGroup; this loses the required antisymmetric/nondegenerate structure
Domain is generalized from the block-paired index type l ⊕ l (guaranteeing even dimension) to an arbitrary Fin n, dropping the even-dimensionality inherent to the symplectic group

As generalized, the statement is mathematically false: e.g. take J = 1 (identity) and M a transposition permutation matrix in Fin 2 — M.transpose * J * M = J holds but det M = -1 ≠ 1, so the hypothesis does not entail the conclusion in general
